description: Removes an identified room and its guest assignments from the selected wedding, subject to payment and checkout safeguards. Uncharged checkouts without a payment method require confirmed cancellation. Completed, refunded or processing payments and active checkouts with a card prevent removal. Payment history is retained. The place is retained unless remove_empty_place is set and the place has no other rooms or retained history; otherwise empty places require a separate explicit removal. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

accommodation_id.description: Identifier of the room to remove from the selected wedding.

remove_empty_place.description: When true, also removes the room’s place if it has no other rooms or retained room history. Defaults to false, which keeps the place.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: remove_my_accommodation
title: Remove Accommodation
